name: Shearlet Transform
definition: A GPU-accelerated implementation of the Alpha Shearlet transform that computes Fourier coefficients once at initialization and performs all subsequent operations on the GPU to allow parallel batch processing.
summary: The Shearlet Transform is a GPU-accelerated implementation that computes Fourier coefficients once at initialization to enable parallel batch processing, differing from the AlphaTransforms library by moving all post-initialization operations to the GPU.
